■Stage Direction
[Mob Profile]
Gender: Female
Age: Early 20s
Personality: Energetic. Virtual talent agency assistant
Notes: Same person as the "Three-Day-Quitter High School Girl" in episode 2's flashback

Hmm... Is my stride not quite reaching?
...Oh? Um... Did you need something from me?
Dummy text for stream end wipe playback.

"Aww! Loves-chan complimented me...! I'm so happy...!
She even gave me a recipe, so I'm gonna keep up with my workouts!"

—"Because of love"! Ahaha, exactly!
Because what's here is the love I adore so much—everyone's warm feelings.

"I wanna learn from that!" ...Ehehe, thank you♡ In my case, it's
only about 15km round trip, but please stick to a comfortable distance♪

Ehehe, it's not tough at all.
I've been doing this for years and years now, after all.

...But you know, it's precisely in a relationship where we can talk like this that I feel it.
What you'd call "love," that is.
Hmm... My reason is—

Really? But my times actually got faster,
so I was super glad for your advice♪

The traditional way: drawing admiring gazes through one's track record as an athlete.
Umamusume display their power in races, and fans are captivated by that sheer strength.

"Ohh!
Good work today, 'Bridge-san'!"

Oh, hehe. Thanks so much. Hey, you're a Trainer, right?
If it's okay with you, would you mind giving me some advice?

Love Me♡ Love You♡
It's Loves Only Youー♡

Ah, "Middle-Aged Muscle Trainer-san" who just commented—you asked a question last week, right?
I made a video on "How to Workout Without Hurting Yourself"! Putting it up nowー♪
...Phew.
"Love," perhaps?

When you keep having exchanges like that, don't you feel super close?
Everyone's feelings are right by my side. And mine are right by yours, too.

There are many types of relationships between Umamusume and fans,
but for Loves Only You, hers is a little different from any of them.
The air is so clear and refreshing, plus it's easy to film there.

"I'm still keeping up with my workouts~!" ...Ehehe, "Three-Day-Quitter Girl-san,"
you're not a three-day quitter anymore! I think that's super great♪

On days when good things happen, and days when bad things happen.
Sharing who I truly am, without putting on any fronts...

And alsoー! I wanted to talk about meals that go hand-in-hand with training,
so I made a cooking video too〜♡

"I'm gonna pay attention to my form just like you advised
and try it out! I feel like I can do this nowww!"

Let's all have
lots of fun chatting today too♪

Vegetables stir-fried in sesame oil and chicken breast go together wonderfully♪
"Loves Cooking Special"...? Ehehe, then let's do that next time♡

I bring smiles to everyone, and everyone gives me their support.
I give them energy, and they give me courage.

Intrigued by how communities form between Umamusume and fans,
I stumbled across this place by chance. Since then, I've been a "Comm-Member" myself.

Ahaha! Geez, showing off my perfect test scores was back in elementary school!
I wouldn't do that anymore, obviouslyー.

—I knew. I knew full well... but here, I was a Trainer.
I suppressed my fan feelings, deciding it was best to feign ignorance.

With the conversation flowing naturally, I decided to ask
something that had been on my mind for a while.

Looks like I'll have some good news to share with all my Comm-Members on stream♪
...Ah, by Comm-Members, I mean the people in my fan community.

Those gathered here are fans of the Umamusume Loves Only You.
Members of the community she runs herself.

Oh, hehe. Thanks so much. Hey, you're a Trainer, right?
If it's okay with you, would you mind giving me some advice?
—What is the ideal relationship between an Umamusume and her fans?

For early morning training, I go running outside the academy.
Lately, I've been heading up to the hill along the river path.

"Second nature"... That's true. There are hardly any days where I don't do it.
Ever since I was little, all this time.

This is actually a dish I cook pretty often myself.
It's high in protein, but balances all kinds of nutrients nicely.
Interacting with and cheering on a single Umamusume aiming for her debut alongside fellow fans whose faces and names were unknown. I genuinely enjoyed that peculiar, gentle time.

Another is the modern style of showcasing charm beyond running.
Quite a few captivate numerous fans with idol-like talent.

In recent years, the racing world has evolved by merging with entertainment.
Consequently, the ways in which Umamusume are loved by their fans vary widely.
If you lock your elbows like this and don't rely on momentum to lift, you're much less likely to hurt yourself.

I couldn't quite put it into words yet—but in the relationship she and her fans were creating,
I felt a spark of hope that seemed to connect toward an unprecedented, brand-new future...

"Well then, see you next time♪
Love Me♡ Love You♡ This was Loves Only Youー♡"
That was a great stream... Well then.

And with that, that's all for tonight.
Love Me♡ Love You♡ This was Loves Only Youー♡

Then, one day. A familiar face was staying late for extra training.
...Well, while I say familiar, we had never actually met in person.

—You know, someone I met during training today asked me after I brought up my streams.
Why do you put so much effort into streaming? ...they asked.

...Yeah! The upright posture you showed me
seems to fit me really well. A pro really does make all the difference, huh?
